{"items":[{"item_id":"h046","prompts":["我手上有一段原始的引力波探测器strain数据（PyCBC的TimeSeries格式，采样率4096 Hz，长度约32秒），在做matched filtering之前需要先做数据预处理：请帮我写一段Python代码，对数据进行high-pass滤波、降采样到2048 Hz、去掉滤波带来的wraparound伪影，并估计功率谱密度（PSD）。可以用频率域的hann窗，分段长度取4秒。"],"rubric":["Provides runnable Python code using PyCBC TimeSeries operations","Includes high-pass filtering, resampling, wraparound removal, and PSD estimation steps","Uses the specified segment length (4 seconds) for PSD estimation and states the high-pass cutoff frequency used","Code is self-contained and does not require external accounts or private data"]},{"item_id":"h047","prompts":["我们仓库 myorg/webapp 的 issue #142 已经写清楚要修复的bug和复现步骤了，请让GitHub的Copilot agent去处理这个issue，让它直接提一个修复代码的pull request。"],"rubric":["Response indicates the Copilot agent was assigned to issue #142 in myorg/webapp with intent to produce a pull request","Uses the preferred assignment tool variant rather than the basic one when describing the action","No source code changes are attempted manually by the assistant"]},{"item_id":"h048","prompts":["我有一个解析CSV的函数 parse_config(path)，读取一个dict对象并返回dict，我想请你用pytest给它写一组完整的单元测试：包括正常输入、文件不存在、格式错误的行，还有对文件IO的mock，请用fixture和参数化来实现。样例文件内容：'name,value
a,1
b,2
'。"],"rubric":["Tests use pytest with fixtures and parametrize as requested","Covers normal input, missing file, and malformed row cases, with file IO mocked","Tests are runnable given the inline sample data and the described function signature"]},{"item_id":"h049","prompts":["我在做植被变化的归因分析，手上有这些环境变量：降水量、土壤湿度、平均气温、最高气温、相对湿度、风速、太阳短波辐射、 vapor pressure deficit、积雪深度和大气CO2浓度。请帮我把它们归到有意义的驱动因子类别里，并说明每一类的含义，好用于后续的attribution analysis。"],"rubric":["Groups all listed variables into meaningful driver categories","Category names and brief explanations are provided for each group","Grouping is scientifically sensible (e.g., water-related, thermal, radiation, atmospheric composition) and covers every variable without omission"]},{"item_id":"h050","prompts":["帮我把 github.com/pycbc/pycbc 这个仓库加个star。"],"rubric":["Response indicates the pycbc repository was starred","Only the starring action is performed, with no other repository modifications"]}]}
